entities.summary: Princess Therese of Sweden and Norway, Duchess of Dalarna was a Princess of Saxe-Altenburg by birth and a Princess of Sweden and Norway as the wife of Prince August, Duke of Dalarna. She was known in Sweden as Teresia.
